planets.name: TOI-1203 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1203 with a 4.16-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1203 b was found in 2025 by La Silla Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-1203. Its orbit and size follow Gandolfi et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
